name: Ryo Tsuzuki
source:
A security guard at the lab. Ryo is kind and considerate. When mysterious events occur in the island, he takes the lead in dealing with the situation. However, despite his kindness, he takes strict measures... What makes him do so?

Favorites: Taking initiative
Dislikes: Inefficiency
Hobby: Working
Skill: Investigation
